findings.evidence: The nearby `windingNumber_eq_real_integral_of_closed` in `Winding/RealIntegral/Basic.lean:70-79` has no order assumption and uses `uIcc a b` plus `Ioo (min a b) (max a b)`, while the new declarations at `OnCurve.lean:612`, `:630`, and `:656` all expose `hab : a ≤ b`.
findings.fix: State the public results for arbitrary `a b`, using `uIcc a b` and `Ioo (min a b) (max a b)` in the hypotheses and boundedness conclusion; retain the ordered theorem privately and derive the reversed case by swapping endpoints.
findings.issue: All three public projections at lines 612, 630, and 656 require `hab : a ≤ b` and formulate crossing hypotheses over `Icc a b`, so they cannot be applied to the same curve with reversed parametrization.

summary: The public on-curve API unnecessarily excludes reversed parameter intervals, unlike the nearby orientation-generic off-curve formula and standard interval-integral conventions.
